Job Details

Role Purpose

The Account Director is responsible for strategic client management, ensuring long-term client satisfaction, revenue growth, and acting as the main liaison between clients and internal teams.

Find and pitch complex opportunities from existing or Greenfields Account. Orchestrating with internal and external stakeholder for Core, ICT and IoT and Techco project

The role consists of: nurturing and fastening large enterprise account to use Indosat B2B products & services, a “close win”. All team members approach with effective and efficient manner, increase the exposure of Indosat B2B products & services in the marketplace and customer centric focus to maintain loyalty.

Responsibility

Sales Execution

• Plan and execute corporate sales activities for Indosat Business services.
• Evaluate and create program to improve customer productivity in term of services usage.
• Coordinate with Enterprise Sales Solution, Marketing, Product Development, Technical and other supporting functions concerning proposal preparation of offering solution and pricing that needed by customer.
• Coordinate with Major Events to retain customer and increase customer loyalty.
• Evaluate achievement of target production and revenue from Customer in Bank and Financial Segment

Account Management

• Prospecting customer and regularly update customer with Indosat B2B products and services
• Manage sales plan with sales team
• Validate & update customer credit rating
• Manage sales team activities
• Manage all sales team pipeline & sales forecast
• Cross/Up Selling
• Manage Bid
• Develop Sales Project Proposals
• Manage sales workforce
• Manage sales performance

Customer Management & Market Analysis

• Conduct reporting of the sales activities and performance
• Perform account monitoring and maintenance, Give feedback to Marketing, Product Development and Technical functions concerning trend of service need, market pricing and customer potential.

Sales & Campaign Management

• Issue and Distribute Marketing Collaterals
• Manage and track leads

Lead, initiate, and accomplish strategic project with strategic customers.

• Initiate new project, conducting and lead the action involving marketing, presales, provisioning after-sales team.

Team collaboration

• Execute and achieve functional goals given by Head of Division (Superior)
• Work co-operatively with other team members to accomplished delegated tasks assigned by managers
• Provide support, when appropriate, for the team in cases of absence or unavailability
• Provide continuous inputs on business process and systems improvement

PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform regular in-process inspections of raw materials, semi-finished products, and production lines according to established quality control procedures and sampling plans.
* Conduct physical, chemical, and sensory tests on samples to verify compliance with quality standards and specifications.
* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters during production to ensure process stability and product integrity.
* Identify and document non-conforming products or processes, initiate corrective actions, and follow up on their implementation.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of inspection results, test data, and quality control activities.
* Assist in the investigation of quality deviations, customer complaints, and production issues.
* Collaborate with production teams to implement quality improvement initiatives and ensure adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment and tools, ensuring proper calibration and functionality.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies.

Job Qualifications**

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-3 years) as a QC Inspector, preferably in a food processing or feed manufacturing industry.
* Strong understanding of quality control principles, GMP, and food safety standards.
* Proficiency in conducting various physical, chemical, and sensory tests.
* Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and quality control documents.
* Detail-oriented with excellent observation and analytical skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in using basic computer software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite).

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

- Develop and maintain client relationships.

- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).
